blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-image personalization aims to equip pretrained diffusion models with the ability to learn user-specific concepts from only a few reference images. Existing methods, however, typically train each concept independently or assume that all concepts are available simultaneously. In practical applications, concepts often arrive sequentially, requiring models to continually learn new subjects, objects, or styles while minimizing interference with previously acquired concepts. We address this continual concept personalization setting by extending residual-space adaptation to the stochastic adaptation process of pretrained diffusion models. Our work achieves the highest concept fidelity among competing continual personalization methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Beyond these empirical gains, the learned residual-space dynamics reveal where adaptation capacity is concentrated within the diffusion model. Restricting adaptation to the identified layers by our method preserves nearly the same performance while reducing the number of trainable parameters by up to 72\%, demonstrating that residual-space dynamics can identify the layers that contribute most to continual concept personalization and directly guide more parameter-efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像的个性化旨在为预先训练的传播模型配备能力,能够仅从少数参考图像中学习用户特有的概念. 然而,现有方法通常独立地培训每个概念,或假设所有概念同时存在。 在实际应用中,概念往往依次出现,要求模型不断学习新的科目,对象或风格,同时尽量减少对先前获得的概念的干扰. 我们处理这种持续的概念个性化设定,将剩余空间适应扩大到预先训练的传播模型的有条理的适应过程。 我们的工作在相互竞争的不断个性化方法中实现了最高的概念忠诚,同时保持几乎零的遗忘。 除了这些经验性成果外,所学到的剩余空间动态揭示了适应能力集中在传播模式内的地方。 通过我们的方法限制对已识别层的适应,几乎保持了相同的性能,同时将可训练参数的数量减少多达72%%,表明剩余空间动态能够识别最有助于持续概念个性化的层,并直接引导更具参数效率的适应.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent text-to-image models such as Stable Diffusion [ 17 , 15 ] and FLUX [ 11 ] have enabled high-quality image synthesis from natural language descriptions, making generative models increasingly accessible to end users. Their flexibility has further motivated personalization methods that adapt pretrained models to user-specific concepts, subjects, objects, or artistic styles from only a few examples.
blocks.zh: 近期的文本到图像模型,如稳定扩散[17,15]和FLUX[11],使得来自自然语言描述的高质量图像合成,使基因模型越来越为终端用户所使用. 他们的灵活性进一步激发了个人化的方法,这些方法使预先训练的模型适应仅从少数例子中得出的用户特定的概念,主题,物品,或艺术风格.

blocks.en:
Personalization methods commonly rely on parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA [ 9 ] to adapt pretrained diffusion models to new concepts. Most existing approaches [ 7 , 14 , 10 , 21 ] perform a separate fine-tuning procedure for every concept, and subsequently merge the resulting adapters into a unified personalized model. In many practical scenarios, however, concepts are acquired sequentially over time as new subjects, objects, or styles become available. Under this setting, whenever a new concept is introduced,
the expensive merging procedure must be repeated to reconstruct the final personalized model. As the number of concepts grows, this repeated merging process becomes increasingly inefficient. This motivates continual concept personalization, where a single model is updated incrementally to incorporate new concepts while preserving previously acquired ones.
The main obstacle to continual concept personalization is interference: learning new concepts can degrade performance on previously learned concepts. At the same time, the fixed model capacity must be used parsimoniously to preserve sufficient adaptation capacity for future concepts.
Several continual learning methods [ 4 , 19 , 12 , 1 ] achieve low levels of interference by constraining the parameter update to a pre-computed safe subspace. The most successful among these rely on layer-wise input statistics to characterize the safe subspace. This procedure cannot be directly extended to stochastic backbones, thus limiting its applicability in image generation tasks.
In this work, we bridge this gap, extending residual-space adaptation to stochastic diffusion models for continual concept personalization. In particular, our starting point is an adapted version of DyRA [ 1 ] into diffusion models, a recent method which we choose for its elegant formulation and explicit theoretical guarantees.
We also introduce a novel systematic evaluation framework for continual concept personalization and show that the resulting residual-space dynamics reveal layerwise specialization, providing a practical tool for guiding parameter-efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh:
个性化方法通常依靠LORA[9]等参数高效的微调技术,使预先训练的传播模型适应新概念. 大多数现有方法[7,14,10,21]对每个概念分别进行微调程序,随后将由此产生的适配器合并为统一的个性化模型. 然而,在许多实际情景中,随着新的主题、对象或风格的出现,概念会随着时间而相继获得。 在这种背景下,每当引入一个新概念时,
必须重复昂贵的合并程序,以重建最终的个性化模式。 随着概念数量的增加,这种重复的合并进程越来越低效。 这推动了概念的持续个性化,即逐步更新单一模式,以纳入新的概念,同时保留以前获得的概念。
持续概念个性化的主要障碍是干扰:学习新概念可以降低以往学到的概念的性能. 同时,必须均衡地使用固定模型能力,为未来概念保持充分的适应能力。
几种持续学习方法[4,19,12,1]通过将参数更新限制在预计算的安全子空间来实现低干扰水平. 其中最成功的依靠分层输入统计来描述安全的子空间. 这种程序不能直接扩展至有条理的骨干,从而限制了其在图像生成任务中的应用性.
在这项工作中,我们弥合了这一差距,将剩余空间的适应性扩大到持续概念个性化的有条理的传播模式。 特别是,我们的出发点是将DyRA[1]改编成扩散模型,这是我们为其优雅的表述和明确的理论保证而选择的一种最新方法。
我们还为持续概念个性化引入了新的系统评价框架,并表明由此产生的剩余空间动态显示分层专业化,为指导参数效率调整提供了实用工具。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: • We extend residual-space adaptation from deterministic language models to stochastic diffusion training, providing a new competitive option for continual concept personalization that mitigates interference while maintaining adaptivity at low cost. • We introduce a systematic evaluation framework for continual personalization that captures concept fidelity, going beyond judging only image-generation quality. • We show that residual-space dynamics can serve as an efficient probe for identifying the layers that contribute most to continual concept adaptation, providing insights into layerwise specialization and guiding more targeted parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Diffusion Personalization
blocks.zh: 2.1 个人化

blocks.en: Text-to-image personalization has been widely studied for adapting pretrained diffusion models to user-specific identities, objects, or styles from only a few examples. Early approaches such as Textual Inversion [ 6 ] learn new concepts in the text embedding space while keeping the diffusion model fixed. DreamBooth [ 18 ] improves personalization quality by fine-tuning the diffusion model using a prior-preservation objective. Subsequent methods such as Custom Diffusion [ 10 ] restrict adaptation to selected cross-attention layers, improving parameter efficiency while supporting multi-concept customization. More recent personalization methods increasingly adopt parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA. Mix-of-Show [ 7 ] introduces ED-LoRA together with structured concept tokens for multi-concept personalization, while LoRACLR [ 21 ] improves composition through contrastive alignment of independently trained adapters.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像的个性化被广泛研究,以将预先训练的传播模型适应用户特定的身份,对象,或风格,仅从几个例子. 早期方法如Textual Inversion[6]在文本嵌入空间中学习新概念,同时保持扩散模型固定. DreamBooth [18] 通过使用前置保护目标精细化扩散模型,提高了个性化质量. 后续方法如自定义扩散[10]将适应限制在选定的交叉关注层,提高参数效率,同时支持多概念定制. 较近期的个性化方法越来越多地采用参数高效的微调技术,如LORA. Mix-of-Show [7] 将ED-LORA与结构化的概念符号一起引入多概念个性化,而LORACLR [21]通过对比性地调整独立训练的适配器来改进组成.

blocks.en: Another line of work reduces interference through the design of the adaptation space itself. Orthogonal Adaptation (OA) [ 14 ] constructs approximately orthogonal LoRA subspaces, allowing independently trained adapters to be combined through simple summation with minimal interference. Although originally proposed in a non-continual setting, its orthogonal structure naturally lends itself to sequential adaptation. Overall, most existing personalization methods assume that all concepts are jointly available during training or are learned independently and combined afterward, and are therefore not explicitly designed for continual settings.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作通过适应空间本身的设计减少干扰. 正交适应(OA)[14]构造大约正交LORA子空间,允许独立训练的适配器通过简单的总和与最小干扰进行组合. 虽然最初是在非连续环境下提出的,但其正弦结构自然有利于顺序调整。 总体而言,大多数现有的个性化方法都假定所有概念都是在培训期间共同提供的,或是在培训后独立学习和结合的,因此没有明确为持续设置而设计。

blocks.en: 2.2 Continual Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 持续适应

blocks.en: Continual learning methods [ 8 ] operate in a sequential training fashion, aiming to preserve knowledge and plasticity over time. Classical approaches rely on regularization, replay, or gradient projection mechanisms to mitigate catastrophic forgetting [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 连续学习方法[8]以连续培训的方式运作,旨在随着时间的推移保持知识和可塑性。 经典方法依靠正规化、重播或梯度预测机制来减轻灾难性的遗忘[23]。

blocks.en: Within diffusion adaptation, C-LoRA [ 22 ] extends Custom Diffusion to a sequential setting by introducing regularization to preserve earlier concepts. Orthogonal Adaptation [ 14 ] can also be naturally extended to continual settings through additive composition of orthogonal adapters.
blocks.zh: 在传播适应方面,C-Lora[22]通过引入规范化来保留早先的概念,将自定义传播扩大到顺序设置。 正交适应[14]也可以通过正交适配器的添加成分自然延伸至持续设置.

blocks.en:
Several methods constrain the parameter update to a safe subspace based on the layer-wise input statistics. Among these,
Gradient Projection Memory (GPM) [ 19 ] estimates layer-wise feature covariance from previous tasks and constrains the new updates to its low-energy subspace.
The more recent InfLoRA [ 12 ] applies the same strategy to LoRA-based fine-tuning, where each task is learned within a fixed low-rank budget.
Building upon InfLoRA, Barinka et al. [ 1 ] propose a dynamic rank allocation method with simplified updates which allows for significant capacity savings. In addition to providing theoretical guarantees for mitigating forgetting, the method demonstrates strong empirical performance on challenging continual language model adaptation tasks.
blocks.zh:
有几种方法将参数更新限制在一个基于分层输入统计的安全子空间. 其中,
渐变投影内存(GPM) [19] 估计与以前的任务相配合的层位特性,并限制其低能子空间的新更新.
最近的InfLORA[12]对基于LORA的微调采用同样的策略,在固定的低级预算中学习每项任务.
依据InfLORA, Barinka等人. [1] 提出动态等级分配方法,并简化更新,从而可以大幅节省能力。 除了为减轻遗忘提供理论保障外,该方法还显示出在挑战持续语言模型适应任务方面的强有力的经验性表现。

blocks.en: Although effective, these approaches have been studied primarily in deterministic architectures. Whether residual-space methods remain effective in stochastic diffusion training, where layer statistics are influenced by sampled noise, remains unexplored.
blocks.zh: 这些办法虽然有效,但主要在决定性结构中加以研究。 残余空间方法在分层传播培训中是否依然有效,其中层层统计受到取样噪音的影响,目前仍未加以探讨。

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluation of Personalized Generative Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 对个性化基因模型的评价

blocks.en: Evaluating personalized generative models typically involves measuring text alignment, image similarity, and identity preservation. Text alignment is commonly assessed using CLIP-based [ 16 ] text-image similarity, which measures whether generated images are semantically consistent with their prompts. Image alignment metrics compare generated images with reference examples, often using CLIP image embeddings. Several works additionally evaluate identity preservation through specialized recognition models such as ArcFace [ 3 ] . However, these metrics are mainly designed for human faces and do not generalize to arbitrary objects.
blocks.zh: 评价个性化基因模型通常涉及对文本的校正、图像的相似性和身份保护。 文本对齐通常使用基于CLIP的[16]文本图像相似性来评估,该方法衡量生成的图像是否与其提示一致. 图像对齐度量法将生成的图像与参考实例进行比较,常使用CLIP图像嵌入. 若干作品通过ArcFace[3]等专业识别模型,对身份保存进行了额外的评价. 然而,这些度量衡主要为人面而设计,并不泛指任意物体.

blocks.en: Beyond specialized identity metrics, a variety of pretrained embedding models have been used to assess perceptual similarity. CLIP [ 16 ] is trained on large-scale image–text pairs and provides representations that emphasize global semantic correspondence between images and language. In contrast, DINO-based models [ 2 , 13 , 20 ] learn self-supervised visual representations without text supervision and preserve fine-grained visual structure and local semantic information. DreamSim [ 5 ] combines multiple pretrained visual embeddings together with human similarity annotations, leveraging both global semantic understanding and fine-grained visual details to produce perceptual representations that closely align with human judgments.
blocks.zh: 除了专门的身份衡量标准外,还使用各种经过预先培训的嵌入模型评估知觉相似性。 CLIP [16] 接受了大规模图像-文本对子的培训,并提供了强调图像和语言之间全球语义对应的表示. 相比之下,基于DINO的模型[2,13,20]在没有文本监督的情况下学习自我监督的视觉表现,并保存精细的视觉结构和当地语义信息. DreamSim [5]结合了多个预先训练的视觉嵌入与人类相似性说明,同时利用全球语义理解和精细的视觉细节,产生与人类判断紧密一致的感知表现.

blocks.en: Overall, most existing evaluation protocols are designed for static personalization settings and do not measure identity preservation or forgetting over time.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,大多数现有的评价协议都是为静态个性化设置而设计的,不衡量身份保存或随着时间的推移而遗忘.

blocks.en: 3 Evaluating Continual Performance
blocks.zh: 3 评价持续业绩

blocks.en:
Evaluating continual text-to-image personalization requires measuring not only the quality of generated images but also how well previously learned concepts are preserved throughout sequential adaptation. Unlike discriminative tasks, where forgetting can be directly quantified through accuracy, there is no canonical notion of forgetting for generative models.
As discussed in Section 2.3 , existing evaluation protocols are primarily designed for static personalization settings and focus on aggregate measures of text or image alignment. In order to assess the degradation of the concept identity over time, it is important to have metrics that distinguish concept fidelity from general image quality.
To address this problem, we first introduce a concept-level fidelity measure that quantifies how faithfully a personalized concept is preserved. We then derive continual evaluation metrics directly from this quantity.
blocks.zh:
评价连续的文字到形象的个性,不仅需要衡量生成的图像的质量,而且需要衡量以往学到的概念在整个相继的适应中保存得如何。 与歧视性任务不同,在这种任务中,遗忘可以通过准确性直接量化,因此没有关于遗忘基因模型的教条概念.
如第2.3节所述,现有的评价协议主要针对静态个性化设置,并侧重于文本或图像对齐的汇总度量. 为了评估概念特性随时间推移而退化的情况,重要的是要有将概念忠诚与一般图像质量区分开来的指标。
为了解决这一问题,我们首先采用了概念层面的忠诚度量,量化如何忠实地维护个性化概念。 然后,我们直接从这一数量中得出持续评价指标。

A generated image may differ substantially from its reference in pose, background, or artistic style while still faithfully depicting the same concept. We therefore introduce concept fidelity , which measures similarity at the concept level rather than the image level.

blocks.en: 3.2 Final Fidelity and Forgetting Metrics

blocks.en: 4 Residual-Space Adaptation in Diffusion
blocks.zh: 4 传播中的残余空间适应

blocks.en: We build upon the residual-space adaptation framework DyRA [ 1 ] , originally designed for LLMs, which constructs layer-wise adaptation subspaces from the input representations. Applying this framework to diffusion models is nontrivial, as these representations depend not only on the input concept but also on the randomly sampled diffusion noise and denoising timestep. We therefore first review the residual-space adaptation procedure and then develop a stochastic interpretation that justifies applying the framework to diffusion models and motivates our implementation.

blocks.en: 4.2 A Stochastic Formulation for Diffusion

blocks.en: A key step of residual-space adaptation is constructing the residual space from layer input representations collected before training each task. For deterministic backbones, this procedure is well defined since each training sample corresponds to a unique layer input. Diffusion models, however, introduce an additional source of stochasticity through the sampled diffusion noise and denoising timestep, so the layer input of a training sample is no longer unique. This raises the central question of this section: how should the layer input space ℋ t ( l ) \mathcal{H}_{t}^{(l)} be estimated for residual-space construction?

blocks.en: From this interpretation the answer to our question directly follows. Since the optimization objective is defined over the training distribution of diffusion noise and denoising timesteps, the collected layer inputs should provide an empirical estimate of the same distribution. Therefore, layer inputs are collected using exactly the same sampling strategy as diffusion training, namely Gaussian noise with uniformly sampled denoising timesteps. This simple step extends residual-space adaptation from deterministic feature representations to stochastic diffusion training by aligning the feature collection procedure with the stochastic optimization objective. Detailed implementation and derivation are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 从这一解释来看,对我们问题的答案直接如下。 由于优化目标的定义是针对传播噪声和去诺定时步骤的培训分布,所收集的层层投入应提供相同分布的经验性估计. 因此,利用与扩散训练完全相同的取样策略收集层积,即带有统一取样的去诺定时步骤的高斯噪音。 这个简单的步骤将剩余空间的适应从定型特征表现法扩展至分色扩散训练,将特性收集程序与分色优化目标相匹配. 附录B提供了详细的实施和衍生内容。

blocks.en: 5 Stable Continual Personalization
blocks.zh: 5 稳定的持续个性化

blocks.en: This section evaluates whether residual-space adaptation can be successfully extended to continual diffusion personalization. We first assess its ability to preserve concept fidelity while mitigating forgetting throughout continual learning, and then examine scalability and capacity preservation.
blocks.zh: 本节评价残余空间适应能否成功地扩展到持续扩散的个人化。 我们首先评估其保持概念忠诚的能力,同时在整个不断学习过程中减轻遗忘的能力,然后审查可扩展性和保存能力。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We conduct all experiments on Concept101 [ 10 ] , a benchmark containing 101 concepts spanning 17 semantic classes, including visually similar concepts, making it particularly suitable for studying interference and identity preservation in continual learning. All concepts are learned sequentially in a rehearsal-free setting, where only the current concept data are available during training. Unless otherwise stated, all methods follow the same randomly shuffled task ordering. Throughout the experiments, we denote DyRA configured with the sigular value threshold τ \tau as DyRA- τ \tau . We compare DyRA with τ ∈ { 0.5 , 1.0 } \tau\in\{0.5,1.0\} against three continual LoRA baselines: Trainable-AB , which optimizes both LoRA projection matrices A , B A,B and corresponds to a continual variant of Mix-of-Show [ 7 ] ; Rank-Fixed-B , which optimizes only the LoRA up-projection A A while keeping the randomly initialized down-projection B B fixed; and OA , the continual version of Orthogonal Adaptation [ 14 ] . Unless otherwise specified, all methods adapt the linear projections in the transformer blocks of both the text encoder and the UNet, and all fixed-rank methods use rank r = 4 r=4 . All experiments are conducted on Stable Diffusion v1.5 [ 17 ] . Models are periodically evaluated throughout continual training. For each concept, images are generated using only the learned concept token as the prompt, without additional textual descriptions, thereby isolating the learned concept representation and enabling a direct comparison of concept fidelity across methods. At the end of training, we further validate the model using diverse prompt templates. Additional implementation details and training hyperparameters are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 5.3 Dynamic Rank Improves Parameter Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.3 动态排名提高参数效率

blocks.en: The performance gains of DyRA stem not only from restricting adaptation to the residual space, but also from allocating adaptation capacity according to the residual-space structure of each layer. We therefore compare DyRA with the fixed-rank OA under different trainable parameter budgets to evaluate the effectiveness of dynamic rank allocation.
blocks.zh: DyRA的性能收益不仅来自于限制对剩余空间的适应,也来自于按照每一层的剩余空间结构分配适应能力. 因此,我们将DyRA与不同可训练参数预算下的定级OA进行比较,以评估动态级别分配的有效性.

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares concept fidelity against the number of trainable parameters for OA with different fixed ranks and DyRA with different singular-value thresholds. Each point corresponds to a different parameter budget. Across the entire range of budgets, DyRA consistently achieves higher concept fidelity than OA with comparable numbers of trainable parameters, demonstrating a superior performance–parameter trade-off.
blocks.zh: 图5比较了不同固定等级的OA和不同单值阈值的DyRA的可训练参数数量。 每个点对应不同的参数预算. 在整个预算范围内,DyRA一贯实现比OA更高的概念忠实,具有可比数量的可训练参数,显示出优异的表现-参数权衡。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Parameter-efficiency frontier comparing concept fidelity and trainable parameter count for OA and DyRA variants. Error bars indicate one standard deviation over three random seeds.
blocks.zh: 图5:参数效率前沿比较OA和DyRA变体的概念忠诚度和可训练参数计数. 错误栏显示三个随机种子有一个标准偏差。

blocks.en: Notably, even under high singular-value thresholds, where DyRA has substantially fewer trainable parameters, it outperforms OA with considerably larger parameter budgets. These results indicate that allocating rank adaptively according to the residual-space structure is substantially more parameter-efficient than assigning a uniform rank to every layer, allowing DyRA to maintain strong concept fidelity under a reduced parameter budget.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,即使在高单值阈值(DyRA的可训练参数少得多)下,它的表现也超过了OA,参数预算要大得多. 这些结果表明,根据剩余空间结构进行适应性分级比为每一层分级高得多的参数效率,使DyRA能够在减少的参数预算下保持强有力的概念忠诚。

blocks.en: 6 Layer-wise Specialization
blocks.zh: 6 分层专门化

blocks.en: Section 5 demonstrated that DyRA achieves strong continual personalization performance while improving parameter efficiency through adaptive rank allocation. Beyond these empirical gains, the adaptive ranks themselves provide a signal of where adaptation capacity is consumed during continual learning, since additional rank is allocated only when new concepts introduce directions outside the accumulated input subspace. This section analyzes these rank dynamics to understand how adaptation capacity is distributed across the layers and how this information can inform future parameter-efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 第5节表明,DyRA在通过适应性级别分配提高参数效率的同时,实现了强劲的持续个性化表现。 除了这些经验性成果外,适应性排名本身也发出信号,表明适应能力在持续学习期间的消耗程度,因为只有在新概念引入累积投入子空间以外的方向时,才会分配额外的等级。 本节分析这些等级动态,以了解适应能力如何在各层之间分布,以及这种信息如何为未来参数高效适应提供信息。

blocks.en: 6.1 Adaptation Capacity Concentration
blocks.zh: 6.1 适应能力浓度

blocks.en: We first analyze how DyRA distributes adaptation capacity across the adapted layers by averaging the allocated ranks over all 101 concepts. Figure 6 illustrates the average rank allocated to each layer. The x-axis indexes the adapted layers in architectural order, and the corresponding module names are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们首先分析DyRA如何通过在所有101个概念上平均分配的等级来将适应能力分布到适应层。 图6显示每一层的平均级别。 x轴按建筑顺序索引了经调整的层,附录D提供了相应的模块名称。

blocks.en: Rather than allocating the same rank to every layer, DyRA exhibits clear layer-dependent allocation patterns that closely follow the repeated transformer architecture. In the text encoder, the allocated ranks exhibit a four-layer periodicity that exactly mirrors the repeated key(K), value(V), query(Q), and output projection layers within each transformer block. A similar correspondence is observed in the UNet, where every group of eight adapted layers corresponds to the self-attention and cross-attention projections within a transformer block. Within every block, the two dominant rank peaks consistently coincide with the cross-attention key(K) and value(V) projection layers, which repeatedly receive substantially larger ranks than all other projections.
blocks.zh: DyRA不是将相同的等级分配到每一层,而是表现出清晰的依层分配模式,这些模式密切跟随反复出现的变压器架构. 在文本编码器中,分配的排名显示一个四层周期,准确映射每个变压器块内重复的密钥(K),值(V),查询(Q)和输出投影层. UNet中也观察到类似的对应现象,每组8个经过调整的层都对应变压器块内的自留心和互留心预测. 在每个区块中,两个主级的峰值始终与交叉意向键(K)和值(V)的投影层相吻合,后者一再得到的排名大大高于所有其他预测.

blocks.en: The repeated concentration of residual rank in the UNet cross-attention K,V projections indicates that these layers consistently consume more adaptation capacity than other adapted modules during continual concept personalization. This observation motivates a closer examination of these layers in the following analysis.
blocks.zh: UNet交叉注意的K,V预测中重复地集中了剩余等级,这表明这些层在持续概念个性化期间的适应能力一直比其他适应模块消耗更多。 这一观察促使在下面的分析中更仔细地检查这些层.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Average allocated rank per adapted layer over 101 concepts.
blocks.zh: 图6:101个概念之上每个经调整的层的平均分配等级。

blocks.en: 6.2 Early Capacity Saturation
blocks.zh: 6.2 早期能力饱和

blocks.en: The UNet cross-attention K,V projections receive the largest residual ranks. We next examine whether exhausting the residual capacity of these layers is associated with degraded adaptation to subsequently learned concepts.
blocks.zh: UNet交叉注意的K,V预测得到的剩余排名最多. 我们接下来审查这些层的剩余能力是否与退化适应后来学到的概念有关。

blocks.en: Figure 7 summarizes the remaining rank of every adapted layer after learning all 101 concepts. Under DyRA- 0.5 0.5 , all 32 UNet cross-attention K,V projections become fully saturated, whereas no UNet layer saturates under DyRA- 1.0 1.0 . Figure 8 further illustrates representative remaining-rank trajectories. While non-saturated layers retain sufficient residual capacity throughout training, representative cross-attention K,V layers under DyRA- 0.5 0.5 steadily exhaust their available rank and become saturated around tasks 77–78. In contrast, the corresponding layers under DyRA- 1.0 1.0 retain residual capacity throughout the entire task sequence.

blocks.en: To assess the effect of this capacity exhaustion, Table 2 compares the final concept fidelity with the average fidelity of the final 20 learned concepts. DyRA- 1.0 1.0 maintains essentially unchanged performance on later concepts, whereas DyRA- 0.5 0.5 exhibits a clear late-task fidelity degradation after the cross-attention K,V layers become saturated. Although this evidence is correlational, the consistent agreement between the rank allocation, capacity saturation, and late-task performance suggests that preserving residual capacity in the UNet cross-attention K,V projections is important for sustaining continual concept adaptation over long task sequences.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这种能力耗尽的影响,表2将最终概念的忠诚度与最后20个学到的概念的平均忠诚度作了比较。 DyRA-1.0 1.0在后来的概念上保持基本不变的性能,而DyRA-0.5 0.5 显示在交叉注意力K,V层饱和后,任务后明显出现晚忠性退化. 虽然这种证据是相互关联的,但军衔分配、能力饱和和和任务后期业绩之间的一致一致表明,在UNet交叉注意K、V的预测中保留剩余能力对于维持长期任务序列的持续概念适应十分重要。

blocks.en: Table 2: Final concept fidelity compared with the average fidelity on the final 20 learned concepts. The reported score are averaged over three seeds. Standard deviations are below 0.007 in all cases.
blocks.zh: 表2:最后概念的忠诚程度与最后20个学到的概念的平均忠诚程度相比。 报告的分数平均为3个种子。 在所有情况下,标准偏差都低于0.007。

blocks.en: 6.3 Layer-Guided Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
blocks.zh: 6.3 层-定向参数-有效适应

blocks.en: The analyses in Sections 6.1 and 6.2 consistently identify the UNet cross-attention K,V projections as the layers that require the largest residual adaptation subspaces throughout continual learning. This suggests that these layers differentiate newly learned concepts through distinct adaptation directions. If this interpretation is correct, restricting adaptation to the identified layers would be expected to preserve most of the continual personalization performance while substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 第6.1节和第6.2节的分析一致确定UNet交叉注意的K,V预测是整个持续学习过程中需要最大的剩余适应子空间的层。 这表明,这些层次通过不同的适应方向区分了新学到的概念。 如果这种解释正确,将调整限于已查明的几层,可望保持多数持续的个性化性能,同时大大减少可训练参数的数量。

blocks.en: Table 3 supports this hypothesis. Restricting adaptation to only the UNet K,V projections reduces the trainable parameter count by approximately 60% (67.56M → \rightarrow 27.12M) while achieving virtually identical concept fidelity ( Q = 0.6496 Q=0.6496 vs. 0.6497 0.6497 ) and comparable forgetting. Restricting adaptation further to only the UNet cross-attention K,V projections reduces the trainable parameter count by approximately 72% (67.56M → \rightarrow 18.87M), yet still preserves nearly all continual personalization performance in practice.
blocks.zh: 表3支持这一假设。 仅限制适应UNet K,V预测将可列车参数数减少约60%(67.56M →\rightarrow 27.12M),同时实现几乎相同的概念忠诚(Q = 0.6496 = 0.697 = 0.6497)和可比的遗忘. 将可训练参数数减少约72%(67.56M ~\rightarrow 18.87M),但实际上仍然保留了几乎所有持续的个性化表现。

blocks.en: Beyond validating the proposed interpretation, these results also provide a structural explanation for previous personalization methods such as Custom Diffusion [ 10 ] and C-LoRA [ 22 ] , which restrict adaptation to cross-attention K,V projections based primarily on empirical observations of large weight updates during training. In contrast, residual-space dynamics explain the same design choice from the perspective of feature-space utilization, providing a principled interpretation of why these layers are particularly effective adaptation targets.
blocks.zh: 除了验证拟议的解释外,这些结果还对以往的个性化方法,如自定义扩散[10]和C-LORA[22]作了结构解释,这些方法主要根据培训期间大量重量更新的经验观察,将适应限制在交叉注意的K,V预测. 与此相反,剩余空间动态从地物空间利用的角度解释了同样的设计选择,为为什么这些层是特别有效的适应目标提供了原则性解释。

blocks.en: More broadly, residual-space dynamics provide a principled way to identify where adaptation capacity is most effectively utilized. Rather than relying on empirical heuristics or exhaustive layerwise search, the proposed analysis directly guides targeted adaptation, enabling substantially more parameter-efficient continual personalization while preserving nearly the same overall performance.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,剩余空间动态为确定在哪些方面最有效地利用适应能力提供了一个原则性方法。 拟议的分析不是依靠经验的推力论或详尽无遗的分层搜索,而是直接指导有的放矢的适应,使参数更有效率的持续个性化,同时保持几乎相同的总体业绩。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Performance of targeted adaptation strategies guided by residual-space dynamics. Values are mean ± \pm SD over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 表3:以剩余空间动态为指南的有针对性的适应战略的执行情况。 值是平均值 ±\pm SD 超过三个种子。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Although DyRA achieves strong continual personalization performance, several limitations remain. First, the adaptation capacity of residual-space methods is fundamentally bounded by the width of individual layers. As continual learning progresses, layers with consistently high adaptation demand may eventually exhaust their available residual subspaces, limiting scalability to arbitrarily long task sequences. Second, the method is implemented only on Stable Diffusion v1.5 and Concept101. Nevertheless, the residual-space analysis developed in this work is considerably more general than the specific adaptation algorithm. Since it relies only on layer input statistics and residual-space dynamics, it can potentially be applied to other diffusion backbones, transformer-based generative models, or broader neural architectures to identify the layers that contribute most to learning new tasks. Exploring these adaptation patterns across architectures may provide further insights into representation specialization and guide the design of future parameter-efficient adaptation methods.
blocks.zh: 虽然DyRA取得了强大的持续个性化表现,但仍有一些局限性. 第一,剩余空间方法的适应能力从根本上以各层的宽度为界限。 随着不断学习的进展,适应需求一直很高的层层最终可能会耗尽现有的剩余子空间,将可扩展性限制在任意长的任务序列上。 其次,该方法只在稳定扩散v1.5和Concept101上实施. 然而,在这项工作中开发的剩余空间分析比具体的适应算法要普遍得多。 由于它只依赖于层输入统计和剩余空间动态,它有可能应用于其他扩散骨干,基于变压器的基因模型,或更广泛的神经架构,以识别最有助于学习新任务的层. 探索整个架构的这些适应模式,可以进一步深入了解代表性专业化,指导未来参数高效适应方法的设计。

blocks.en: Our work shows that residual-space adaptation extends naturally to stochastic diffusion models, enabling continual concept personalization with stable performance, negligible interference, and strong parameter efficiency. Beyond its empirical performance, the residual-space dynamics observed during continual adaptation reveal how adaptation demand is distributed across the adapted layers. By identifying the layers that consistently require new concept-specific adaptation directions, it provides a structural interpretation of existing adaptation strategies and directly guides more parameter-efficient adaptation. We hope this perspective motivates future work that uses adaptation dynamics not only to improve continual learning algorithms, but also to better understand layer specialization in modern generative models.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作显示,剩余空间的适应性自然延伸至散射模型,使得概念能够持续个性化,具有稳定的性能,可忽略不计的干扰和强大的参数效率。 除了经验性表现外,在持续适应期间观察到的剩余空间动态揭示了适应需求如何在各适应层之间分布。 它通过确定始终需要针对具体概念的新适应方向的层次,从结构上解释现有的适应战略,并直接指导更具参数效率的适应。 我们希望这一视角能激励未来利用适应动态的工作,不仅用于改进持续学习算法,而且用于更好地理解现代基因模型中的层层专业化.
